_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: a PS3 project is one game - a homebrew executable booted directly, a disc image, or a dumped disc folder as one .zip.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: A PS3 executable (.elf, .self) booted directly the way a modded console would, a disc image (.iso): a decrypted image, or a Redump image with its disc key in the Disc key slot, or a disc dumped as a FOLDER packed into a single .zip. The archive is read where it lies and never unpacked, so it may be as large as the disc; store its files rather than compressing them and the game's big files stay seekable. A disc game's own EBOOT.BIN is not enough by itself, because the rest of that disc is where its data is.

slots.title: Disc key
slots.help: The 32-character disc key that decrypts a Redump PS3 image (the .dkey file distributed alongside it). Not needed for a decrypted image or a homebrew executable.
